![](images/d6/d63963154e858da324418ef8f29aa8e4f309355b7cd6ad105a89f96506027248.png)

Consider the circle of radius $2$ centered at $(-1, 2)$, as shown above. Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for $θ ∈ [0, 2π)$, traverse the circle once in the counterclockwise direction starting at the point $A(1, 2)$?
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Translate the standard radius-$2$ circle to center $(-1,2)$:
$$x=2\cos t-1,\qquad y=2\sin t+2.$$
At $t=0$ it starts at $(1,2)$ and moves counterclockwise.
